Industrial Engineer Data Scientist Marketing Analyst

I'm a Data Scientist and Industrial Engineer with a background in digital marketing, advertising analytics, and business strategy.

I currently focus on Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) — building end-to-end pipelines from raw advertising data to causal sales decomposition and budget optimization. My work answers the question that last-click attribution can't: what's actually driving sales?

Previously, I led the advertising department at AMZ Advisers, where I built data pipelines, predictive models, and the operational systems for a team of 11 analysts managing international brands on Amazon.

Before that, I worked as an Advertising Data Strategist at Snowball Partners, using data analysis to create and optimize campaigns across digital channels.

I'm trilingual (Spanish, English, German — Goethe-Schule Abitur) and actively exploring opportunities in marketing analytics and MMM roles in Europe and remotely.

Expertise

📐
Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
End-to-end MMM builds: adstock and Hill saturation transforms, OLS and Bayesian regression, sales decomposition by channel, response curves, and budget optimization. Privacy-safe by design.
🤖
Machine Learning & Data Analytics
Training and implementing ML models for classification, forecasting, and pattern detection. Creating dashboards and automating reports for data-driven decision-making.
⚙️
Data Pipelines & Automation
Python ETL pipelines for multi-source ingestion, anonymization, star-schema warehouse design, idempotent loads, and API integration for real-time performance tracking.
📊
Advertising Analytics
Five years optimizing paid media across Amazon, Google, and Meta. ROAS, TACoS, ACoS analysis, keyword harvesting, wasted spend identification, and KPI framework design.
